04/ 12.04.2024: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Dhurwa P.S. Case No. 154 of 2023,
registered under sections 498A/323/34 of I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned C.J.M, at Ranchi.
3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that marriage of the informant is itself in dispute.
He submits that the informant was married with Naresh Nayak and she has separated from him by way of Annexure-3 thereafter it is alleged that she has solemnized marriage with the petitioner.
He submits that allegations are general and omnibus against the petitioner and other inlaws and inlaws have been provided privilege of anticipatory bail by the learned Sessions Judge.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer on the ground petitioner is husband and allegation of demand of dowry is there.

5. Considering that only on paper transaction informant has separated from Naresh Nayak, it appears that thereafter she was living along with the petitioner, there are general and omnibus allegation against all the accused persons and inlaws have been provided privilege of anticipatory bail by the learned Sessions Judge, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the learned C.J.M, at Ranchi, in connection with Dhurwa P.S.
Case No. 154 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the petitioner will not change his mobile number which is indicated in his Aadhar.
